communication-basics-1-greetings.description: Choose a polite greeting for the time of day.

t-1.text: Buongiorno is one word for a polite daytime greeting.

t-2.text: Buonasera is one word for a polite evening greeting.

t-3.text: Ciao is one word for an informal greeting or goodbye with friends.
